comparator_notes.telemetry-wire: op=launch: expected.argv_tail is the last two arguments of `daemon`; the core must accept them and take the consent from the second (on/off). op=update: expected.body is exactly what the app PUTs to /atomic/v1/telemetry (enabled, user_id or null, every tag the webview sent); the core must accept it and answer enabled = body.enabled, has_user = user_id is not null, and the tags restricted to its allow-list.
